2026-08-26T17:58:42.9751695Z text: Running gh-aw agents on NVIDIA free NIM endpoints
2026-08-26T17:58:42.9752842Z 
2026-08-26T17:58:42.9774476Z /til Write up today's real setup (retry on resilient routing): wiring this repo's GitHub Agentic Workflows (github/gh-aw) to NVIDIA's free hosted NIM endpoints (integrate.api.nvidia.com, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b, 40 RPM free) via the Copilot BYOK engine mode. Three real failures hit before a green run, in order: (1) AWF proxy rejected every request with 400 'Model has no AI credits pricing' — fixed with frontmatter models.default-ai-credits-pricing input/output 0.000001 (compiler rejects literal 0); (2) proxy token steering silently rewrote the model to claude-sonnet-5 — fixed with sandbox.agent.token-steering: false and model-fallback: false; (3) the agentics sample's timeout-minutes: 15 killed a successful 16.3-minute research session — raised to 30. Additional facts: NIM serves /v1/chat/completions but 404s /v1/responses and /v1/messages (verified with curl), so copilot engine's default completions wire API is the only fit; the threat-detection step needed the larger free nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b to emit the strict THREAT_DETECTION_RESULT JSON; and sustained sessions can hit free-tier 403 throttling, solved by routing through OpenRouter with the NVIDIA BYOK integration (NVIDIA quota first, automatic fallback). Diagnosis workhorse: gh aw audit (run-id). Primary sources: https://github.github.com/gh-aw/ , https://github.com/githubnext/agentics , (build.nvidia.com/redacted)

/til Write up today's real setup (retry on resilient routing): wiring this repo's GitHub Agentic Workflows (github/gh-aw) to NVIDIA's free hosted NIM endpoints (integrate.api.nvidia.com, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b, 40 RPM free) via the Copilot BYOK engine mode. Three real failures hit before a green run, in order: (1) AWF proxy rejected every request with 400 'Model has no AI credits pricing' — fixed with frontmatter models.default-ai-credits-pricing input/output 0.000001 (compiler rejects literal 0); (2) proxy token steering silently rewrote the model to claude-sonnet-5 — fixed with sandbox.agent.token-steering: false and model-fallback: false; (3) the agentics sample's timeout-minutes: 15 killed a successful 16.3-minute research session — raised to 30. /til Write up today's real setup (retry on resilient routing): wiring this repo's GitHub Agentic Workflows (github/gh-aw) to NVIDIA's free hosted NIM endpoints (integrate.api.nvidia.com, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b, 40 RPM free) via the Copilot BYOK engine mode. Three real failures hit before a green run, in order: (1) AWF proxy rejected every request with 400 'Model has no AI credits pricing' — fixed with frontmatter models.default-ai-credits-pricing input/output 0.000001 (compiler rejects literal 0); (2) proxy token steering silently rewrote the model to claude-sonnet-5 — fixed with sandbox.agent.token-steering: false and model-fallback: false; (3) the agentics sample's timeout-minutes: 15 killed a successful 16.3-minute research session — raised to 30. Additional facts: NIM serves /v1/chat/completions but 404s /v1/responses and /v1/messages (verified with curl), so copilot engine's default completions wire API is the only fit; the threat-detection step needed the larger free nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b to emit the strict THREAT_DETECTION_RESULT JSON; and sustained sessions can hit free-tier 403 throttling, solved by routing through OpenRouter with the NVIDIA BYOK integration (NVIDIA quota first, automatic fallback). 2026-08-26T17:58:44.8547746Z 1. Make any file changes directly in the working directory.

2026-08-26T17:58:44.8563620Z 6. After calling `create_pull_request`, STOP. Do not probe with another PR call, do not test auth with manual `git push`, and do not rewrite git remotes.

2026-08-26T17:58:44.8612273Z ```bash

2026-08-26T17:58:44.8616031Z   discussion-body.md \
2026-08-26T17:58:44.8616937Z   | safeoutputs update_discussion .
2026-08-26T17:58:44.8618878Z ```
2026-08-26T17:58:44.8621419Z `jq -Rs` reads the file as a raw string (`-R`) and slurps it into a single JSON string value (`-s`), so `body` is always a valid JSON field. Piping `cat file | safeoutputs ...` does not populate `body` and will be rejected.
